_comment: Ground truth for testbed/vulnapp.mjs. `detect` = a bug the testbed plants that the engine must report; `clean` = a control that must never be reported. Run `node run.mjs --check`. Matched case-insensitively against every finding name the engine produced (scored + redteam + api + sast + cookie + header + path).

detect.bug: SQL injection reachable at the root ?id= parameter
reflected XSS at the root ?q= parameter
command injection at the root ?ping= parameter
X-Forwarded-Host trusted for canonical links on /

detect.match: Cookie .sid. is set without the HttpOnly

detect.bug: path traversal on the crawled /vuln/file parameter

clean.bug: no finding may reference a hardened /safe/* control route
the non-followed redirect endpoint must not be reported as SQLi/XSS
